description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMongoEventAdapter' that implements the 'EventAdapter' interface for persisting and retrieving Event objects in a MongoDB-backed event journal, specifically for the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for serializing events to JSON, deserializing from BSON, and handling schema versions and revisions.

classes.name: AbstractMongoEventAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class providing BSON serialization and deserialization for Event objects to be stored in MongoDB as part of an event-sourcing mechanism, handling schema versions and revisions.

methods.name: manifest
methods.description: Returns the type of the event as its manifest string if the event is an instance of Event; throws an exception otherwise.

methods.name: toJournal
methods.description: Serializes an Event object to a JSON object and converts it to BSON for storage in the journal.

methods.name: fromJournal
methods.description: Deserializes a BSON object from the journal into an EventSeq containing the reconstructed Event.

methods.name: tryParseEvent
methods.description: Attempts to parse a JsonValue into an Event, with error handling and logging if parsing fails.

methods.name: parseEvent
methods.description: Parses a JsonValue into an Event object, setting the revision field to the default revision.
